headline: 2 killed as two firefighting helicopters collide in mid-air in Greece
summary: The tragic accident occurred on August 2 during a wildfire fighting operation in the West Attica region.
details: Two people were killed after two firefighting helicopters collided in mid-air over the Satha area of West Attica, Greece.
The incident took place on August 2 while the aircraft were engaged in an operation to extinguish wildfires in the region.
Emergency services rushed to the scene following the collision, but the victims could not be saved.
Authorities are investigating the cause of the mid-air collision during the critical firefighting mission.
caption:

Authorities are investigating the cause of the mid-air collision during the critical firefighting mission.
